text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp, a time for Tracen Academy
students to train at the
beach and push
their abilities to new heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Well... That's what it's supposed to be.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Woooow! Feel this energy? The
adventure's about to start!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We should be at the campground on the
beach, but somehow we've
ended up in
this forest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a desperate attempt to clear my
confusion, I try to recall how we
got here...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The waves! The wind! The thunderous
squalls! I can hear the sea
calling!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But it must wait! Another place calls!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The forest! In the deepest woods is where
beetles wage war for sap.
Only there can I
draw out my latent power!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Raise anchors, Trainer! We're outta here!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Boarding pass—check. Cards, chess,
checkers, and go board for the
plane
ride—check

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: There, that's everything! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Woohooo! Green as far as the eye can see!
Now begins our true camp
of summer!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
To the forest we go! It's time to catch
bugs!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We should be at the summer camp by now,
but for some reason, the
two of us are
wandering around a forest...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a rainbow-colored mushroom! Hey,
those things are edible, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aw heck, what's a little poison, huh?
Shouldn't be anything more than
a minor
emergency!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Right, nothing major...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm Gold Ship's trainer. It's about time I
check that wild spirit of hers!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's up with you? You're all quiet.
Come on, we're about to go bug

collecting.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huuuuuh?! You feeling okay? 'Cause that sounds amazing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm? Beep-beep! Beep, beep! Golshi Radar signal detected! The ruins are thataway!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
To me, my trainer! There are vast riches
waiting to be discovered!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're off and running through the trees on
Gold Ship's big summer
adventure!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a fork in the road. Do we go right?
Or left...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait... I'm the mighty Gold Ship—I reject
these options and substitute
my own!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We go through, Trainer! We don't follow in someone's footsteps, we carve new paths for our own!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
whoooa! Why's there a cliff?! I can't
stooop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly we're running down a steep
slope through the thick brush!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Heck yeah, this is the best!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... I know I'm amazing, but that was so much running. Even I'm tired.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But you kept up the whole way. Not bad,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Nicely said, my fine fellow! You'll be
top-class yet!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then I've got a little gift for ya...
Check it
out. The sun's setting over
the sea.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All this scenery, the adventure, and
everything! This is what I've
always wanted
to show you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aw, I just made that up. Doesn't change
how good this view is
though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The whole ocean is sparkling in the
sunset.
It looks just like a crowd
of fans waving
light sticks at a winning concert.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm really pumped to see all sorts of
other
stuff with you too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So let's aim for the big one
together—being the world's greatest

treasure hunters!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right! Towards the sun we go! Only a
true Umamusume gets the
urge to run into
the sunset!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: URAAAAGH! With me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As usual,
I have no idea what she's actually
talking about, but I feel that the
adventure has really narrowed the distance
between us.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: How the heck should I know?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although we're unsure of where to go, we
make it out of the
wilderness and back to
Tracen Academy... together.
